text: This is one of my favorite places to go. Atmosphere is just the perfect blend of rustic and modern. The staff is always on point with great drink and good recommendations as well as great service, Jess behind the bar is aways smiling and you can tell it spreads throughout the place! The beer they make in house is solid with a good rotation. Their menu has something for everyone including bar snacks if you just need something to hold you over till you get home. Well priced and friendly is hard to beat! Plus a crazy fun outside area when the weather permits.
Highly recommend... the chicken is yummy- prepared perfectly and super spicy. Don't be scared to walk on in. Some of the nicest people we've met in Nashville.

Coming from ny u don't get food que unless it's mighty Quinn's bbq. Sooooo dang good I wanted back twice while on vaca. First time I went alone. Wings r crazy and so is pulled pork. I went end of June so check my reviews at Jackies_food_jaunts on Instagram

Oh my goodness!! Some of the best food my husband and I have EVER had. I got the California Bennie, which is the eggs Benedict with tomato and avocado, with their country potatoes and a side of bacon. They cooked my poached eggs to perfection, gave lots of hollandaise sauce, cooked my bacon to the perfect crispness and seasoned the potatoes perfectly. My husband got the turkey, bacon ranch club and he inhaled it. They roast their own turkey in house and thick slice it for the sandwich. So delicious! The service was amazing and we highly recommend this place. Be sure to put your name on the waitlist early and know the wait is well worth it!
Good food, great atmosphere and awesome service. I plan to come back and have the Bandeja Paisa and arepas :). Please come out and try it for yourself! I promise you will love it too!!!!

Can't do zero stars but someone buy this place out and put in a real McDonald's! This is a large order of fries. Everything sucks here.. was too hot to go all the way to Oro valley McDonald's...never make that mistake again

Met a friend in the parking lot for car by car dining. Ordered food for pick up. Employee who answered was very courteous and helpful. Ordered the pork sandwich with fries. Was ready for pick up in about 20 minutes. Nicely packed in a bag with the condiments. Sandwich was so incredibly good! Nice ratio of pork to toppings and the fries were crisp and had nice flavor. One of the best meals I've had in a long time! Can't wait to be go back when I'm in the area. Easy to eat in the car too! Great job!

First and last time. The positive part of this review is that they practiced very good social distancing with an enclosed door to take your order from. As for the actual food,I will go item by item. We picked up our order on time. The Miso soup was tasty but room temperature. The vegetable fried dumplings were undercooked ( and cold). Pad Thai was warm and, well, it was not Pad Thai. My best guess is rice noodles with some non-Thai  sweet sauce on top. I couldn't eat more than 2 fork's full.The slice of lime was, also, warm so I assume it was all microwaved. The sushi was questionable because it also was not as chilled as sushi should be served, so that made me nervous. The California roll was the best part and colder than all the rest. I can only hope I don't get sick later tonight. Good luck to all.

If I could give this zero or negative stars, I would.  While riding around the area on May 10, my significant other & I decided to go into Paladar 511 and have a look.  I'd heard the food was good, so we wanted to check the atmosphere and have a drink.  We walked in and as I do with any restaurant at which I do not have a reservation, I walked up to the bar to order a drink.  I was immediately chased down by Mr. Host, telling me the bar was only for dining customers.  I asked how could I simply get a drink and get a feel for the atmosphere since we were not sure we wanted to dine there yet.  He said he'd have to go to get out drinks and we would have to stand in the  approximately 4' x 8' foyer/waiting area with the others who had reservations that the event ready yet. I didn't mind waiting anywhere except that we really just wanted to sit at the bar like one can do in pretty much every restaurant I've ever been to including worldwide.  So I thought that was weird.  Anyway, hI I'll drinking our drinks, I went back up to Mr. Host and asked him if I could put our name on the list because we decided we wanted to try it.  He said sure and our wait was not long.  When it was time for us to be seated he brought us to another bar in the restaurant and said this would be our seats. So I still had some of my wine left and my significant other had finished his drink, so we sat for about 10 minutes noticing that the bartender was very busy. So after about 10 minutes, I spilled a little
This experience was absolutely amazing. My fiancé and I were on our anniversary and this restaurant made it a night to remember! The quality of food is worth the price and the staff was wonderful.

I love Steak n Shake. Everyone is always nice to me and it's a real diner feel. Drive thru also available. Shakes!!! The flat burgers are cheapish but so are the prices and they have very affordable combos. I downoaded the app and got a free shake. Paid it forward to the drive-thru cashier working during 'Rona. Good place.for kids and families. Probsbly one of the t best restaurants in Tampa.

If I'm ever on Death Row and I get asked about my last meal, it will be the Filet Roberto at Roberto's Trattoria & Chophouse. I'm pretty sure my wife Donna will say the same. I've had steak at some of the best steak places in the country and there's no comparison.

They have extremely limited hours.  Fans of authentic mexican food tend to rave about this place.  I am not a fan, so thought everything was bland, but that's just my own personal preference.  Everyone I dealt with there was friendly and we didn't have any errors with our order.

I set a reservation and even with COVID and not full capacity they were very quick to seat us on time. The chefs were amazing and the food was even better. It was my moms birthday and they even brought her out a plate of fried ice cream! So amazing!

I can't use words to describe how unbelievably good the food is here. The short rib in particular is just so so so fantastic. This place should be packed all the time and reservations should be just as challenging as Zahav (but I'm glad they're not).

The price point here is great, as well. If this restaurant were in New York it be twice as expensive. Philly, I hope you appreciate what you have.

I always go into beachside cafe to order food for years. Tonight was a shit show and the owner should know. The waiters were playing around like there wasn't a customer in sight. My glass of wine was served to me with other people's wine on the tray table that were a lot healthier than mine. Two good looking girls walked in way after my friend and I who had not been asked what we wanted but when those good looking girls walked in way after us they were served right away. I had to go up to the workers and remind them that we wanted to place an order to go. I was not told ahead of time that my 6 pack of beer to go was going to be $40 + dollars. The service was absolutely horrible tonight and I left with very bad energy not wanting to be a patron of this restaurant ever again. That makes me very sad.

Food is consistently good, sometimes even great given it's "fast food".  On my last visit at the Westchase location I found many dirty tables, items on the floor under tables and the bathrooms a mess.  These items are a turn off for me, but will not stop my visiting PDQ, I may just try the drive through next time.

Ok, I had been here once about a year ago and thought it was just fine, but we've been back a few times in the last several weeks and it's such a great casual spot! Wonderful service too!

First off, $1 beers?! I don't know how or why, but it's amazing. They have basic domestics and a few local beers for $1, imports and some nicer locals for $2, and then lk more specialty beers for $3. Such a steal! 

The bar food is also on point. We have tried the fried pickles (chip style), and they recently threw in fried jalapeños with it for a spicy flare! You can still ask for them original style without jalapeños though. The boudin bombers were good but a little small (we are hungry people, haha). And the loaded creole nachos were flipping awesome!!
COVID-19 update: Call them, they're doing takeout, but I'm told they're not on any of the delivery apps.

Amaaazing. Crst is somehow flaky and bready, I don't understand. All the fillngs were balanced, herby, well-salted, refreshing, savory.

Favorites were corn one, ham one, and caprese.

Liked quinoa one least, mostly tasted the goat cheese. (Though I'd still eat 10 of them!)
This is my favorite place to eat Pho. I usually come here 2-3 times a month. The service is great and the food is delicious!

Absolutely a must if you visit Nashville. It's like sitting in your grandmas kitchen having breakfast. The food is great, all of it. The country ham is wonderful. The fried pork chops and gravy are my favorite. It can be a wait on the weekends if you don't get there early but there are things to see and do on the grounds and it's worth the wait.

Visited this restaurant for the first time. Got served cold food and the food not worth almost $17. I asked to speak to a manager, a guy named Kevin came over and told me there was nothing he could do since I at some of the food already. Well I have to eat it to know that it's not right...he got argumentative with me and insulted me by saying, I'll replace the half that you didn't eat... a picture of what he originally served me is posted on this review, that he obviously thought it was ok to serve. Will never go back!

We stopped by after visiting Barnes museum. The waiters were very attentive. The food I like the most was red chili sauce dumplings. Soup dumplings were slightly sweeter than we used to but it was tasty. Wonton noodle soup wasn't special but tasted ok.

We ordered for delivery and after 90 minutes I called and got a manager on the phone who explained that the deliveries all hit at once and he apologized by sending a $20 gift card and a card for a free appetizer with my delivery. I'd say he did a great job with a challenging Friday night!!

Last week was my first visit at the new location... and it was lovely! Met up with friends and kids for breakfast on a Wednesday at 9:30, were able to sit on the shaded patio in a corner. Service was great, food was great. I really enjoyed the lemon corncakes with blueberries and lemon curd. Good portion size (I took one home to eat later), and the curd was tart, sweet and addictive. My friends really seemed to like their orders are well (Mom eggs!) Be aware, the pancakes are HUGE. Like, hanging over the sides of the plates huge. No idea how they manage to flip them in the kitchen. My teenage kiddo bragged he was hungry enough to eat the entire thing, but cried uncle halfway through.
Super delicious! Got my order of the chicken pho to go and the process was super easy and the waitress was very nice!

I was turned onto Jaco by a client and the food is tasty and fresh.  The cod tacos this round were a little dry .
One thing that was disappointing is that we were TWO people and we got a plastic fork for each type of taco order ...... hmmm what about some stainless steel ?  With a place with a natural vibe you would think they would pay attention to the environment.
The smoothies were tasty too but again plastic straws and cups 

Up your game and you will do better for business and the environment

Amazing pizza. Found this place here on yelp and had to try it. It beyond exceeded my expectations. The tomato pie is amazing and the other pizzas were great too. I ordered ahead for a specific time and delivery was right on time. I wish I lived closer so that I could get it more often. So good!
Excellent! I will definitely be going back here next time I'm in Santa Barbara.  If I could give it more stars I would!
Good and interesting brunch. Must get the watermelon bruschetta.  Great one-off restaurant w amazing one-off meals.
Went here for hot pot only this time. It was so good! The meats, seafood and vegetables were all fresh. Love the spicy broth as well. I would definitely come back again and again!

Just stopped here the other day. I go to Chinatown often but I hadn't noticed this place before. I am a big fan of Shanghai style food, as I spent 2 years living there. I had previously only tried Dim Sum Garden, but as I was walking around Chinatown, I saw this suddenly and I gave this a go. Great authentic taste. Excellent 小笼包. Best of all, reasonably priced. Will be back again!

Granted it has been a few years since I've been to a Wingstop, but wow what a decline! The employee at the counter asked me four times if "this was to go" Each time I told her it was for here. Then when I asked for two beers she said I couldn't take beers to go. Please look at the picture of my "wings" next to a quarter. These are fancy chicken nuggets. Not coming here

First time visiting Nashville and heard this place was worth the wait! The line was wrapped around the building. However, the line did move fairly quick. Once we got seated, I did not feel rushed at all during my entire experience. The pecan pancakes were delicious and can't wait to go back to try their choc chip pancakes. If you like hash browns and variety of flavors, you'll love the medley. Customer service was amazing!

We didn't get our full order today. So bummed since we live 45 mins away... I specifically asked if we had it all and the girl helping us said yes. We also had 2 scopes of carnitas instead of the 3 from the order. next time I will look at it all before leaving. Or next time I will just go to California Taco Taqueria instead.

Whenever we are in Delaware, we always go to Bank's Seafood.  Tonight, Dave Banks and his team completely knocked it out of the park when it comes to serving delicious seafood! I can confidently say the best seafood restaurant in all of Delaware. If you love scallops or salmon, I tasted both and they were outstanding.  Personally, I had their filet mignon and it is as good as the best steak restaurants I've had across the US.
When I saw this place I don't imagine what kind of food they have it is wonderful plenty of flavor this place is amazing very kind people, clean I'm back one or thousands times again!!!

I just want to say that everything was amazing! The staff was very friendly & prompt with my order. Patrick & Gage made sure there was absolutely no wait. The bagels were perfectly toasted, hash browns were so delicious. Definitely recommend this place to anyone.

This was my first going to P.F. Chang's and probably will be my last. The food is very average and is not worth those prices. I ordered the wonton soup which was pretty pleasing (but it can't be that hard to mess up soup). For the entree I ordered the sweet and sour chicken with a side fried rice which was average at best, no real flavor to the chicken and the rice tasted like boxed rice from the supermarket. Now bao donuts are bomb! And would be the only thing I would get there again. Overall great service but mediocre food.
Amazing! Honestly this is about even with my favorite sushi place in the area. Super clean and fresh and reasonably priced! Conshohocken needed a place like this added to Fayette street.

Server/manager with a bad attitude.
Myself and 3 other co workers went here today for lunch. The food was good but the service was terrible. When we placed our orders one of my co workers asked for cheese dip, the server asked which size (which we were not aware there were multiple sizes) she said large. When she received her check the large cheese dip was 10.99, she was floored considering her lunch was less than the cheese dip. We grabbed a menu to confirm the price and all that was listed was one size and it was 5.99. We asked the server and he couldn't provide on the menu where the 10.99 price was showing. I asked to speak to a manager and he said rudely I am the manager, I then explained how ridiculous the price was he said he couldn't do anything about it. He said now you know for next time and another coworker chimed in and said there won't be a next time. We work for a pretty large corporation in the area and will tell our other co workers not to come here. He finally decided to adjust the ticket but only $2.75. We over heard him tell another co worker "this is America" which we still have no idea what that means. So lesson learned we will not be spending anymore money with this restaurant. We also play softball locally and last season went there for a celebration dinner and spent well of $200... NEVER AGAIN!!! I hope you're happy with yourself Luis H.

I have been living near Angelo's for more than 10 years and I am embarrassed to say I just ordered from them! We got the backwards pizza and wow was it good!! Delivery was fast too. Will be ordering from them from now on

We were in the area and had about an hour before having to return to the airport...I searched for burgers in the area (didn't want the same chain food we can get at home). I'm so glad I stumbled upon the yelp reviews for The Ranch Scottish Highland burgees, because it is a place we would have never stopped! It is a tiny building in the middle of a parking lot.  I rarely eat burgers but oh my gosh -- SO GOOD!!! I got the Little Jo (provolone, grilled onions, ketchup), well done....it was so juicy and delicious!! My son got a double cowboy with bacon and we were both so happy with our food we barely spoke while we ate in the car (there are two picnic tables outside the building but it was HOT out so we ate in the AC car). The only thing I might change is to toast the bun a bit because they do get a little soggy with the burger being so juicy. But we ate them so fast it didn't really matter! Get plenty of napkins! And the fries!! Fresh and perfect!! So glad I stumbled upon this local gem!!

Stopped in at a nearby store on a Saturday evening after Black Friday 2019, and the place was packed. Looked here and saw the rave reviews and decided to come in for dinner. I am very happy that I did! Quick summary, the food was absolutely excellent and I would definitely recommend this place to anyone, especially a seafood lover like myself, because all of the dishes we got involved seafood and were all quite good. But, I was in between giving them 3 stars vs. 4 stars. So why 3 stars as opposed to 5? Mainly the service! (5 stars for the food, 2 stars for the service.)

For food, we tried the fried calamari as an appetizer, along with the lobster macaroni and cheese, and the shrimp and scallop oreganata with angel hair pasta. I have to say that the chefs here really know how to cook their seafood. Between the lobster in the macaroni, the calamari, shrimp, and scallops, NONE of it was overcooked, which is a rarity in seafood, especially with things like calamari. Every item was deliciously flavorful and tender. And the lobster macaroni had a good amount of lobster in it... they were not as cheap as I am used to with other places that make the dish.

The service was bordering on awful. I saw another server doing a much better job of tending to her tables than ours did, and even asked if they wanted dessert when our server did not ask. He forgot to ask (or maybe was trying to rush us out), and then handed us the bill, but took it back when we asked for dessert ourselves. (Also,

Wow !! Found this place by accident when ordering on bite squad when our regular places we order from happened to be closed. Best find in a long long time. Everything we got was the best of Mediterranean food we've had here in St. Pete. 
Amazing falafel, grape leaves, tahini, chicken kabobs, hummus, all of it. 
I can't believe how much food showed up... even what I would consider a life time supply of pita bread that was totally warm and toasty when it came by delivery. AND it appears they get their pita from a local place in Tampa (as the pita came in the bag). yeah for keeping it local. 
Adding this place to our list of regular places to get dinner.

I typically have always enjoyed the various Patachou foundation restaurants. I feel that they have a great mission behind what they're doing for the community and I enjoy the health and nourishment that their menu options provide. I hadn't been to this location in a while and I'm used to the menu option being quite different but I did appreciate the options that they had.

The staff are always so friendly and they're always so accommodating to any preferences and dietary needs and restrictions on individuals may have. I find that if somebody has an allergy this is the place that you should go as they are so kind and ask questions if you have any thing they should be aware of.

I had the falafel bowl which was delicious. I very much so appreciated the crispiness and warmth of the falafel as it was nice and crunchy. The kale was marinated beautifully and the sauce was just right. I would admit there was a little bit of the dishware I did feel that there was a little too much salt however that can sometimes become in at restaurants. In general I left feeling refreshed nourished and that I had just had something healthy and good for my body. 

To anyone that is vegan, vegetarian, gluten-free you should definitely give this spot a shot as I am certain you'll find something on the menu to satisfy your body.  

This spot is doing great with their Covid precautions and they also have seating outdoors in cubes that have space heaters on the inside so that you are completely eating in

Awesome cafe.  The menu is extensive for a breakfast place and so many delicious choices. The place is clean and the service was top notched. Our server was very efficient and helpful with suggestions on what to order. Prices were good and the food is definitely worth stopping in for. We will go back.

Food - Amazing. Margaritas - Amazing. Service - Amazing. Day date with the husband today went so freaking awesome thanks to Boca. Salsa is always fire. And the atmosphere is on point. The beautiful weather today definitely bodes well in their favor since outdoor seating is the only option, but Our server was very attentive as well, and they never let us go without our delicious margarita. Will definitely be back next month!! Oh and try the Boca Balls. Didn't even know about them till today and will now forever get them every time.

Had to have a special meal near and dear to my heart for my first official meal as an Indianapolis resident, so I decided to go with a Pittsburgh Favorite, Primanti Bros.  I was so happy to see they had an Indianapolis location.  Being a newbie, I wasn't sure about the parking.  I just parked in  a lot down the street, but it was $10 and I am not going to shell out that much every time I go down there.  When I was leaving, I saw the garage for the mall on Washington Street and it said $3.  That's more like it, and maybe they validate if you eat there.  I'll have to inquire next time I go.  The place looks like Primanti Bros locations in Pittsburgh.  Now, I have take issue with all the Colts stuff.  That's the only reason they don't get five stars.  I know this is Indianapolis and the Colts are the team here, but I have seen PLENTY of Steelers fans so far, here.  I don't think you'd lose any business if you stuck with the hometown team.  I also didn't see any Iron City Beer.  I could have overlooked it.  Pittsburgh Brewing Company could also be scaling back on distribution again.  I ate at the bar, and my server was very nice and very attentive, but not overly attentive, which is what I like.  Everyone in there was nice.  I ordered the turkey and provolone, without the slaw.  It is the only Cole Slaw that I care for, but unfortunately it does not care for me.  However, the sandwich was outstanding.  You cannot beat the thick cut Italian Bread and the classic size is plenty for
Philly cheesesteak is So good. Service is always fast and friendly. We love coming here on Fridays when the cheesesteaks are half price.

Went at 7 am right when they opened for takeout at their new takeout window. We were greeted by a very pleasant male worker who took our order and our food was ready in about 5 minutes. This breakfast burrito was $10 and was the largest burrito I've ever tried to tackle in my life. Some of the menu looks pricey but you get your money's worth! Excited to go again!
Still amazing! Lamb kabobs were super tender i thought they were filet. Love the Greek salad and gyro, tender with crispy edges.
Pizza is delicious. Coming back from Florida where they can't seem to get it right it's nice to get a pizza that is delicious and super filling. So glad we found this place in Burlington.

This place is pretty tasty. I was unsure because of the location of this restaurant, but the food was good with good sized portions and they even give you a discount for using cash. I'm not sure how often I'll come back because of the location, but solid food!

understaffed if not inexperienced. Food is good. 
waiting for half an hour for main dish is one thing, for cold dishes and ice water too? Oh ice water I had to ask for twice. 
The waitress is running around looking very busy but there are only three group of customers. All waiting, and ALL have asked for water, missing order or "where is my dish" etc.
What's going on?

I ordered from this place on grubhub, delivery took very long but the restaurant did have one driver at the time. The kani salad was my favorite, it was a good size portion. I would definitely order that again.

Somehow managed not to discover this place in my neighborhood until recently, but I'm glad I finally did. 
I'm an olde tyme New Yorker, and had been missing my olde tyme NYC Italian deli-style food. No longer. The meatball parm and caprese salad were perfetto, and for good measure I had a bagel & lox that tasted exactly like home. 
Will be going back regularly.

Being from New York and relocating to Nashville this was the first place that we were actually satisfied with their New York style pizza pies. We tried other local pizzaria's but they cut their pizza into about 20 slices that are triangles and squares. Real pizza should always be 8 slices in triangles unless it's a Sicilian pie which should be 12 slices in rectangles. The cheese and the sauce remind us of pizza from New York and their crusts are cooked just right. We have moved further away from this Sal's location but we still stop by Sal's for a pizza whenever we're close by.

Weird smell in the restaurant. Food was disgusting I asked for my sausage to be well done and I ended up with burnt potatoes. Egg was blah sausage was not cooked the way I asked. The biscuits were good that's the only thing I recommend. My friend was given burnt toast and burnt potatoes as well. Waitress was sweet but not very attentive as she was eating her breakfast at the table next to us, weird experience definitely would not return.

We had a fantastic meal here. The fresh mozzarella and prosciutto appetizer was a perfect start, followed by a very large Caesar salad with home-made croutons. We finished with entrees of Chicken Carbonara and Pasta Bolognese. Both were delicious. We brought a bottle of wine and then bought a bottle of Barolo, which was an excellent pairing for our meal. This place is a hidden gem for awesome Italian food with service to match!
Great BBQ & smoked "meats". We take all out of town guests so they can see the great BBQ STL has to offer!

Uggg. Been eating here for years.  Food on the decline. 1/2 chicken was like jerky perhaps cooked on Tuesday and reheated today. Smh. Loaded fry side wrong. Brisket dry....   Togo order at 50 bucks for two entrees and a a donut oh yea the donut. Always good how couldn't it be? Just not as good as normal.  Place looks like it's closing but... should've got the same thing from a small shop of bbq around the corner. donuts saved the day and the only reason we placed the order.  Had a beer while I waited kind of pricy for a family restaurant.

good stuff. we have ordered from La Vera twice and each time the pizza was nearly identical. we ordered the Big Cheesy Pepperoni pizza and it was very good and so hot that steam escaped the box when we opened it 

it took about an hour or so, slightly less. if you live in the Charlotte/ White Bridge area this is the place to order from.

Kinda pricey but is still very good and portions are genrous. The menu is never ending and even thought it's not a sushi type of restaurant, the teriyaki chicken is soooo good especially if they serve wirh the grilled banana but that's hit or miss . If you are gluten free, they have a flourless cheesecake- VERY rich but good!

Please try their Ahí Tuna Bowl- AMAZING 
Presentation was super cute & a perfect portion for my meal. I got my food in a timely manner since I was at lunch. Will go again for sure. Ask for this item - it's new I believe!

Every time i order from this place it's amazing. The staff is friendly and the food is ready when they say. I've tried many different items on the menu and never disappointed. Tommy Tots are the ish, i have trouble sharing them even though it's a large order. Highly recommended.
The food was great!  Loved the bao buns and had thr. Hefs tasting.  The flavors are great, I would totally go here again! Make sure you make a reservation!

I have been vegetarian for 3 years now. I asked specifically for NO meat whatsoever in my salad. (The manager is the one that took my order btw) I start eating my salad and find at least 5 little pieces of chicken as I'm eating it. I go to pour the bowl out since i could no longer continue to eat it, and find MANY more pieces at the bottom. I was disgusted. I went to tell the manager because they should be informed so they don't make a mistake like that again. Her response was, "okay." Didn't offer anything. So then i tell her again how serious it was and all she says is "do you want me to make you another one or something?" I am highly disappointed. There was not even an apology or anything. will not be coming back!

Just.enjoyed a "to go" lunch that was off the hook!  Delicious Bbq brisket sandwich and a amazing side of mac and cheese suggested by the over the top lady behind the bar.  Oh and a to go 6 pack of the beer I enjoyed was only 6 bucks!  Budweiser is more than that and tastes terrible

The customer service was very good. The vibe in the a restaurant is very authentic . All my food tasted very good especially the empanada de queso and the plantains. The only I wish was that my portion was bigger but otherwise I would definitely recommend this place.
As shown in the photo, these 3 cuts of short ribs cost ~$27 including tax/tip. The cuts lean toward the fattier side. Also must grill yourself. All in all, probably not worth it.

Covid or no Covid this place was disgusting.  It's dirty and dank. You certainly can catch some disease here. You can not overlook filth. From the left over rice in the chair when I sat my tush down to the sticky menu; the meal started off with a bang. The waitress gave attitude when we complained and asked her to clean them; can you say white trash bitch! The food was so-so; the cook felt " butter was better" which is true if you like to run to the bathroom or the ER for cardiac arrest . However, I certainly wouldn't recommend the former here because the bathroom had urine on the floor and caked on poop on the rim on the bowl. If you don't barf from that; I don't know what would. The manager/hostess couldn't master wearing her mask and wore it below her top lip. She was also rude and had trouble keeping the tables clean and providing good customer service. She literally through the doggy bag at us as we were departing and didn't offer enough fortune cookies for all our guests. No worries; I'm sure there is not much good fortune coming Fuji's way. I highly suggest in these uncertain times you make the certain decision to  either stay home or go somewhere else.

Where do I start! This was amazing, but pricey! WORTH every penny though. We didn't have a reservation, but ended up getting a two top table ASAP for my fiancé's birthday. The ambience of this place is wonderful and during our dinner there was a female singing softly in the background. I had the NY strip and my fiancé had the lamb. Cocktails were amazing. Overall, wonderful!

Had a reservation. Got seated. Waited 10 minutes to be greeted by our waiter. Ordered teas to drink and an appetizer. Got drinks. 40 minutes later told us didn't have the appetizer we ordered. So we ordered dinner. 40 minutes later we got our food. Had to ask for silverware. And soy sauce. We were done eating by the time it showed up. The portion size was lunch size too. Not impressed. I think I will save my time and money and go to Chick Fil A next time!!!!

The best sushi I've had in Tampa and in Florida. Ebisu never disappoints wether you're getting take out or eating in. Those ladies ROLL IT UP!!! I'm not sure what they put in the rice, but it's so beautifully seasoned and cooked to perfection. The fish they use is so fresh I swear they caught it minutes before it was rolled. The rolls are simple but delicious. I don't think there's been a roll i don't like. My favorite has to be the Florida and Red Dragon Roll , absolutely bomb. I honestly dream about this place on a daily basis. 11/10 recommend this place to everyone I know . Love you Ebisu

Great breakfast and coffee!  
Enjoyed the avocado toast (twerked) and husband actually could not finish the biscuit and gravy with scrambled-eggs on top!  Wonderful!
Solid breakfast/brunch place. You really can't go wrong with most things on the menu. Still trying to not spend much time indoors and they now have outdoor seating which is a big plus.

This place was incredible!!! From the check in process, to seating, service and then the food!!! 5 star!!!
Biscuits and gravey were hot, fresh, and with great taste. 
Blueberry pancake was sweet and delicious!!
Coffee was served in a nice cup that kept the coffee hot.
Melissa was our waitress and was on the ball and still took the time to talk and get to know us.

This place is a must when in Reno.
We will be back and are so excited to see this place winning!

This Cajun spot is unique and adds to the diverse amount of options available in The Reading Terminal Market. They allow you to try a few items that are displayed such as the gumbo, jambalaya, and etouffee. I liked the etouffee which had a slight kick of heat to it.

I ended up getting the jambalaya with had shrimp, andouille sausage, chicken, and some vegetables. The chicken was a bit dry and not as tasty as the sausage and shrimp. The rice was cooked in a tomato-based sauce and actually not bad for cajun food. I also got their alligator sausage on a stick. It was very unique and the wrapping gave it a nice chew. Their cornbreads were decent.

It's nice that The Reading Terminal Market has different types of cuisines. This spot in particular brought me nostalgic NOLA vibes. I would definitely want to try their po boys in the future.

First time we ordered from Blaze and was so excited because they had a keto crust pizza.  Our pizzas arrived in about 15 minutes which should have been a clue.  The pizzas arrived ice cold and the toppings added were a RAW.  Seems that the pizzas were precooked and they tossed the toppings on and delivered them without even being placed in the oven.  Disappointing considering it would have probably been pretty good had it been cooked and at least warm.

Really great find, as we stumbled into it out walking one evening. Really great staff, and the place is very Covid compliant. Simple menu, and a lively bar area. Ordered the burger -- solid, nothing fancy, on par with chain restaurants.  Also had the pulled pork -- very tasty, and the white sauce is authentic and delicious. Definitely a good place to enjoy live music and have some good eats!

Today I had literally the worst take out service I have ever received from a restaurant . I ordered 5 chicken fajita meals at 7pm , was told on the phone they are a little backed up and it would be ready in an hour to and hour and 15 minutes . Well at 8:45 they come out and say we are sorry we are out of fajita chicken . And they only have steak . So I suck it up and deal with it . Finally at 9:10 ( ten minutes after they close my order comes out ) . The entire time I'm there other people are getting their orders . And people are being sat for dine in . This is normally my go to for Mexican cuisine but after this experience with not even so much as an apology or a offered a glass of water while I wait . I will never return .

I have been to this restaurant a number of times.  I can tell you that the crepe is very large so if you order it, plan on sharing it or make it your meal.  The crepe is not as flavorful as I'd hoped but it's not bad.  The summer rolls, (not fried) were filled with mostly lettuce, so I thought they could have been a little better.  Now the pho is great.  Portions are great and flavor is super.  I prefer the shrimp pho.  My husband has had the spring rolls and they were good.  He also had the shrimp fried rice which was light and fresh.  The service is very good at lunch.  The evenings are a little different.  The evenings have a different crew and they don't seem to be as good at handling crowds but everyone is extremely friendly and polite.
Had the the tuna which was pretty good. Fries were on point with the ranch. Would drive from far away fir this. Muuuuuuuuuuuurrrrr!!!

Ok, this was a disappointing experience. It was a small museum for such a legend and for two reasons. One, less details about his life and fewer exhibits than expected. Two, terrible crowd control. They were letting as many people as would buy a ticket to just enter making it VERY congested, hard to see exhibits, read details and get a decent pic of any thing. Unless Johnny Cash is one of your too three heroes in life, save the money and time. Instead, buy a good book about his life and watch a documentary.

This is the best Mexican place in this area HANDS DOWN! Try their tacos al pastor and camarones de la diabla. Their complementary chips and the 3 salsas are very addictive. My hubby enjoys their fajitas. Their prices and portion sizes are generous. Good service, too. Friendly and helpful staff. Make sure to reserve your tables for weekends cuz they get packed!!

Was in town for the weekend and my niece too me to this place. Its a beautiful and clean place . Good food and nice plating. Staff is super friendly. I love that they have a patio to sit outside. Will be back next time I'm in town.

This zaxbys is HORRIBLE! The staff doesn't pay attention to orders, too busy messing around that SEVERAL times my order has been wrong. It's blatant disregard for customer service and they could care less. Extremely rude employees and i will go out of my way to avoid this place in the future.
The fried Wong tons are terrible ! The shrimp friend rice is okay its not really worth it

Tried to order through Grubhub and when delivery was 40 minutes past due I called the restaurant. The woman was very rude and blamed me. She claimed my phone number was wrong and the driver tried contacting me. She confirmed that my instructions were to leave the order and call the number listed. When I explained that I have a camera that would alert me to the arrival before the driver texted me she told me she was too busy and hung up on me. I wanted to support this local business but I will never order from this place again

This is a very nice addition to Brownsburg. The sushi is made up front and the hibachi in the back and brought out to your table fairly quickly. So far everything that I've tried has been really good. There is a lot of food with the bento boxes. Sushi is made to order.
This isn't a fancy sit down type of restaurant and I'm glad the prices don't show it, but it's not fast food either.

This is one of my Go-to places for craft cocktails. There is always some new and interesting combinations on the menu. The drinks a well balanced and creative. The bar is dressed up to  look like a tiki hut. And they have tiki mugs available for purchase. So fun! 

If you are a NOLA local, it's a nice little place to escape the usual. The tiki theme makes you feel like you're somewhere in a beach town USA. The only thing missing is the sound of the ocean instead of the French Quarter.

That being said, y last visit was for the Miracle "sippin' Santa" Christmas pop-up. Such a great idea for the holidays. It really makes you feel festive. There are Christmas themed drinks and the holiday decor is taken to the maximum. I'm sorry I didn't go a few more times. I won't make that mistake next year.

First off, I didn't know this place was at this location - but I loved it! (And yes it's open during COVID!!) You walk in and it's much more spacious inside than appears on the outside. Very cute interior, and things are properly spaced out.

The wine here was great, variety of drys and some sweets. Along with some Sangrias as well. I got a flight of the reds, and loved trying them! The Malbec was not what I expected, yet still good for a tasting. Really liked the others, but my favorite was "Kevin's choice" - very unique flavors, loved the vanilla that stood out in this wine!!

I went here with with a friend for her birthday, and the service was good!! Very attentive.  The one improvement I would suggest is that they spend a little more time telling you about the wines, flavors, how the make it etc. I would much prefer that to just reading it off the menu. Maybe if we would have sat at the bar we would have got that, I'm not sure. I would suggest the employees at least asking if customers would like to hear more about their wine, because if I would have had that it would be 5 stars hands down. 

Either way, I know I'll be back and I highly recommend you trying it as well!!

Mmmmmm!!!  We loved our lunch here!  The setting and vibe provided a perfect resting spot, meal, and break, from our full day visit to the National WW2 Museum, just a few blocks away.  In fact, a former museum employee recommended it.   Tasty and attractive, healthy plates!  Want to come back, next time in NOLA.

This place has so much potential but a lot of work to do! We started at the bar where the bartenders were nice as could be but still learning drink recipes three weeks in. Unfortunately when we sat down it got worse. It took us 20 minutes to get a drink, our food came out 2 minutes later. I ordered the Jidori Chicken and the mashed cauliflower was freezing cold and it was missing the black beans. My fiancé had the enchiladas and thought they were good. Unfortunately I couldn't say anything about my food because our server was too busy schmoozing the locals to ever check back. I know it's new but doubt we'll be back!
If this isn't a five star dive I don't know what is.  Friendly staff. Reasonable prices. Not sure what else you need

Low key coffee shop with ample seating.  Not so crazy loud that you can't have a meaningful conversation.  Christian vibe.  I don't know much about the cause.  Coffee was solid and my son enjoyed his Italian Soda.  Ample parking.
Chronic and tasty, freshly made food! Big fan of this spot and I'm actually about to place an order right now. Get it while the getting is good!
We had a lovely dine in experience. Staff was friendly and the food was exceptional. Would definitely recommend.

Came here to Brickside because we were in the area and the few times I've been here prior to quarantine was always a good experience, so we wanted to support them after quarantine as well!

We were a little early but they were able to seat us almost immediately. Everyone was following Covid protocols (if that matters to you. Distancing plus all employees in masks). 

We were greeted by our server and she took our drink orders in a timely fashion. 

Food was delicious. I had a house salad to start and it was nice and fresh as if it just had come straight from the garden. We ordered an angus burger, and the chicken wrap. Both delicious. The burger was nice and juicy and cooked properly, the spicy jalepeno chicken wrap was indeed spicy and very tasty!

Lastly, we went for the peanut butter pie. You must get this great treat if you come here! Big enough two people can share and still unable to finish! It was light, the crust was amazing, the filling was sweet and decadent! 

I can't recommend this place enough! Definitely would be worth a trip if you aren't from the area! It had a great ambiance to it as well. Well worth the trip!

They cater during the pandemic above and beyond expectations. I ordered a selection of 4 different entrees to share with my family. We missed dining out and having some good breakfast food. They give you so much advice on how to make your food as fresh as possible just like how you would get it from the restaurant. I was so impressed with how beautiful their catering was to take home. They make sure you have everything on the side to make your breakfast great. The food was phenomenal as always even as a take out.
I love this place. Authentic food like I get at home. Customer service is great and I am always greeted by the owner when I go in.

Have been here many times. Food is good and staff are very friendly. They follow social distancing and wear masks. Food is a little on the expensive side but will definitely eat here when at Peddlers Village.
Celebrated Manny's bday at this restaurant last night. The service was great and the food was amazing.

Yep, been back here a few times since my first review and none of my experiences have been wondrous, stellar or even a-okay.

(I am about to use an old, grammatically bad Philly expression from my youth...the 'positive anymore') Anymore, Spice Finch has added a weekday lunch to their other dining time slots. On top of that, in addition to the regular lunch menu, they offer an 'express' deal-$17 for one sauce + one accompaniment + one sandwich or salad. Spice Finch has so many great reviews, it felt like I just needed to try it one more time. There I go again, ignoring my intuition. Other reviews be damned!

When I arrived at 1 p.m., I was the only diner in the place and when I left at a bit after 2, that was still the case. Before I get into my food experience, let me say that service was fine. Not overly cordial but prompt and professional.  

I did go for the express lunch and started with the crudites and muhumara sauce. The muhumara was under spiced and way too chunky for some of the vegetable scoopers-specifically the runner beans and the halved cherry tomatoes. It also came with dip appropriate, lovely, mild watermelon radishes and sliced Persian cukes. I wound up dumping the sauce into the veggies and then adding them to my sandwich when it came. 

Also ordered a cocktail called Two and the Four which is snap pea infused vodka, mint, lemon. Of course, as always happens to me, it was served in one of those frou frou coupe glasses that I despise. If I knew that in advanc

Food was delicious and timely, although packed and pretty busy they were still attentive and polite which is appreciated. 
There was three of us, total came out to about 60. For the amount of food ordered; which was a lot, that's not a bad price.

Food is very good and normally service is great. Tonight we went to have something to eat and listen to music. They had tables outside. Waitress was awful! Bugged us to Eder and then when we did basically ignored. Music was sooooo loud we had to scream with one another. Pleaded with musicians, owner and staff to turn down but that didn't happen.... and we were outside remember! We love their food and like the owners but this night of screaming our conversation was terrible!
Coming here for years! Always have good experience and service. I usually place large orders when we do go here and the staff has always been pleasant and hasn't messed up any of orders so far.

Great service during Covid. We recently discovered Tamarind chicken, which is thin and dry pieces of chicken in sauce with onions and pineapple - we love it and it's a nice addition to our usual entree orders (we always get multiple to share because with Thai food being so yummy how can you be happy with just one?!). The red curry had a nice kick and I liked it a little more than the green. Massaman was a nice change of flavor - more sweet and no kick, and good potatoes. Pad Thai is always a winner. Takes about 30 minutes for the order.

I hate to say it...Jacks has become nasty. Had breakfast this morning with the family and after being seated at a table that looked like had a finger paint contest and everything was just gross. It's slow, it's Monday, wipe down the table. The signature dish with dry biscuits, gravy that was a salt lick and no meat over under cooked potatoes sucked. The over medium egg was perfect. The bathrooms look like something on 4th street and is filthy. Lay some paint, and maybe don't make your bathrooms look worse than a truck stop in Arizona. With all Reno and sparks has to offer with great food, this staple of great food in sparks is horrible.

I just love the food here! The pizza is absolutely amazing, the selection rotates daily. I love that they use seasonal ingredients, the store is very clean and inviting. Service is wonderful, they are very knowledgeable about the product and eager to help. Prices are a bit high, but the quality is well worth the splurge. Great option while in Montecito!

Found this place here on Yelp because it was close to the hotel I was staying at while in the Tampa/St. Petersburg area. I was with three other people and when we arrived I thought we were at the wrong place because the outside looks like an office building. Once inside, it's not the nicest looking place, not horrible just average. There is outside seating available with a cute little pond or maybe it's a lake surrounding the outside seating area.
Our waitress immediately came to take our orders and was very nice and efficient. I ordered a Margarita and was pleased that it was that pre-made stuff. They have a nice menu with a good variety of choices basically bar food but everything we had was pretty good. There was also an area for private events. Only complaint was that there was some customers that came in that was not wearing a mask and it appeared no staff person addressed it.

Pretty normal NJ diner kinda place, but food was better than I'm used to for avg NJ diner fare. Had a cheesesteak, a diner staple, and it was awesome. Gooey cheese mixed with cut beef. A decent roll.

Service was cool because the server came around exactly when we wanted him. He was like a wizard: never late or early, always showing up exactly when he meant to. Price was diner price point, no more, no less.

I really appreciated that it wasn't super bright like many NJ diners. It had subtle lighting inside and wasn't wrapped in neon outside. If I was coming here with a hangover, it'd be nice.

I'd go again if I was passing through the area.

I genuinely can say I'm never giving this place my business again. To start, I'm a doordasher and the signage for getting your food at this Royersford Chick Fil A is not clear at all. I didn't make the correct turn to park in the proper Doordash spot and one of the workers at this location asked me if I could read... (obviously I can). Being a leader in customer service, I was disappointed. I said I was sorry and she gave me attitude and said, "Do NOT do that again...". I ignored it, I understand they're probably stressed because they are busy 24/7. I waited 20 minutes for my order which is extremely long. At first I thought they were just busy and it may take awhile. Another doordasher parks right next to me and this co worker (not even within a minute) comes out with both his order and mine. Not sure if it was a coincidence or she purposely made me wait. I'm leaning more towards the "purposely made me wait" because the look she gave me through the window glass when I picked up the food was like enough to seal the deal.

This is my favorite salad spot. I love the southwest salad and I could eat it everyday. Fast service and my order is always right!! I'm sad that it is not opened on Saturdays but I understand during these times. I have been to all 3 locations and the service is consistent!!

The food was cold and verging on inedible.  My order was all messed up.  I called to let them know I had food missing and I was hung up on, called back asked to speak to the manager and he was equally as rude as the first person and completely incapable of dealing with a customer.  I told him if this was the way they were going to treat their customers I would not order from them again and he said "good"...  if you are looking for good hot food and great service don't order from Rocco's, your better off putting a Digiorno.your oven.

Truly authentic Mexican food in Bristol PA. This place is so easy to miss, as it's in the back of a small Mexican grocery store. As you pass through the store, you can tell it's authentic. Once in back, there are three tables and a deli-type counter. You order by number with maybe 10 choices. My favorite is the chicken tacos that come three to an order with nicely seasoned chicken, cilantro and onion. The salsa verde is a wonderful compliment. The chicken quesadillas are also fantastic with such good queso cheese. Come git you some, just don't tell others. Great little joint that you'll want to keep to yourself.
Fresh hot and delicious chicken onion rings jalapeno poppers mmmm.. even the buffalo sauce n regular hot sauce was amazing .. coming to live here

After landing at PHL and checking into our hotel ~ we hit the streets to find lunch and and an afternoon cocktail.  This was exactly the kind of place we were searching for. A bar that served deliciousness. We sat at one of two window seats ~ watching the entertainment of the city folks passing by. Our server was a feisty and equally friendly young gal. She shared enough about herself to get a lively conversation going, making us feel comfortable enough to not only eat but sit and laugh for awhile. We ate their take on a Jalapeño ranch Philly cheesesteak. It was fabulous. The bread itself was warm, light, with the flaky crust ~ probably anything that you put in it would be mouthwatering fabulousness. This sandwich was #1. I had my usual Moscow Mules... which were made perfectly.  I left full enough that I only had a salad for dinner.
Fantastic hole in the wall Italian! Chicken parm dinner was great! We really enjoyed all of it!soup was good, bread very tasty, pasta  and a ton of leftovers that reheated perfectly

Ok so the Brussels sprouts need to be glazed with more sugar and also need bacon bits the steak tar tar is very mediocre and honestly just a no go. THE MAC & CHEESE is excellent.... wouldn't change a thing...drinks DELISH. Waiting on our lamb order now... I'll let you guys know with another update when it comes

Gotta get the Pablo Honey (I've had a few). Egg rolls are insane. Keep the chipotle queso if your main entree has chips or fries. I got the Turkey BLT and exchanged the gruyere with ghost pepper jack which gives it a nice amount of heat that the avocado aioli really compliments.

A surprise like no other for 2 foodies happened to be of Indian descent. Philadelphia has had Indian restaurants galore and they have all failed to impress us. IndeBlu was very special. The ambience was great but the food was simply amazing and so was the service. We ordered the tasting menu and it was a good call. The combination of Indian food with an European flair made this a unique restaurant. The chicken and lamb we had ordered were tender and cooked at the right levels. Different dishes cooked at appropriate temperatures and they catered the spice level to our level which is higher than normal. The desserts are very unique with the western blend to the traditional recipes. I have written over 300 reviews for restaurants and there were only 2 other Indian restaurants I had given 5 stars to and IndeBlu would be the third one. This is not a restaurant for people who wanna shovel Indian food. It's about quality, unique tastes and incredible service. Kudos

I just witness the worst service to a senior citizen tonight. This gentleman has been waiting for his order even before my brother got his order (and my brother came wayyyy after him)... the older gentleman even asked an employee that was passing by to see what was happening to his order. The employee kept on doing other things than go check the man's order!!!  The wait was to the point that we went up to the counter for the gentleman to ask what happened to order (he was order number 90). The girl found his ticket still waiting to be served. The girl stated they will bring it right to him. We waited again that it was to the point the older gentleman had to come up (keep in mind he was walking with a cane) and ask for his order. The man was pretty upset and i don't blame him!! By the way, the inside of the restaurant was not too crowded to get one person to check the order for him. This Culver's needs to straighten up!! The one on Hillsborough Avenue is on point on their quick and precise order!!!
To add on their very slow service, I had the experience at the drive thru about 3 weeks ago where they forgot to bring me the order that i needed to come in to get my order. I let that slide  but for this senior citizen I was disappointed!

We really like Chick-fil-A.  Their product is usually very good. Today I tried the Fish Filets.   I like cod, but the fish was very thin and mostly breading.  I would recommend that you stick with their Chicken.  I think the fish will only be offered during Lent.  That's OK with me!

Came here for take out last week during era of COVID19. Had been putting it off for many weeks but so happy we finally made it!

Ordering online was simple and they called once our order was ready. Reasonably sized menu with a variety of options but not overwhelming. Everyone told us to get the Momos so we did. And boy were we glad we did! Even held up well under takeout. Crispy on the outside. Very unique blend of spices on the inside. Chicken and beef were our favorites but the vegetable was still solid. Also came with beef broth (Wasn't sure what to do with it?) and another dipping sauce. 

Had the slow cooked goat and the sweet potato noodles for entrees. Goat was cooked well and had the bones in with a good amount of gravy to go with the rice they gave us. Sweet potato noodles were an interesting idea and also delicious! 

Nice people. Good system for food pickup without too much contact. Restaurant looks nice for whenever they're able to open up. 

Delicious food that is different than other food you get at Chinese or Indian restaurants. Definitely worth a try!

The food was amazing and the customer service was great too. I'm a sucker for palaak paneer and theirs is probably my new favorite. I Ioved the bright, clean dining room and I look forward to dining in with Persis one day.
Wonderful Gluten Free menu. The GF french toast was so nice and moist. We always stop here when in SB as their food is fresh, and tasty and even organic!

Food was well prepared but prices are positively ridiculous. 41 $ for a piece of salmon on a salad plate with a few mushrooms. Friends asked for our thoughts, honestly We cannot recommend this restaurant due to the crazy prices.  The dinner portion for scallops was 3 for i believe 38$.  It comes with NOTHING. Salad was less than a cup of twigs for 17$.  We were there with someone who had dined there before and they felt the prices had gone up considerably.  Our servers were excellent.  We wont be back.

We've only gone here for the 1S and it's probably the most unique thing you can eat. It's spicy, sour, hearty and just really delicious. Pretty much every type of meat in there too plus shrimp. Super clean restaurant. Cash only.
Only chips and salsa were good. I got lunch chimachango was to be stuffed with beef chunks, well it was hamburger meat. Wasted money. Cheese sauce is white cheese very watered down.

Great Pizza . It's my go to. Best in Warminster. I've been to almost every pizza place in my area and this pizza delivers even though it's take out. Not too greasy but i love. It flops a bit but it's a great when u fold it. Hardly any flop folded

Sushi was decent, however the rice barely covered the seaweed and there was so many spots that had no rice at all. About half of my sushi had no rice at all very disappointed with that! For the price I expected higher quality sushi.

Food and price is decent although the place is not poppin on a Friday night. We split the check and paid and were about to leave when the waiter (the only one there) came back to us to ASK FOR MORE TIP because he said it was "not nice." SO rude and unprofessional, will not be coming back

Burgers, chicken sandwiches and hot dogs in addition to ice cream this indoor outdoor location is just a stones throw from 5 points in Levittown.  Tasty made to order "fast food" style food is served up just as fast and satisfies far better then BK or McDonald's

The White Dog Cafe in Wayne, PA bills itself as a farm-to-table restaurant and lives up to that phrase.  Lot of transparency on the menu with the farms that they source their proteins from which to me is important if the restaurant is serious about being sustainable.  I had the Green Circle half chicken - chicken was perfectly cooked, pickles were a funky additions, fries were a strange addition to dish.  Not sure why go with a high quality chicken like Green Circle and then pair with fries that seemed like they came out the bag?  If you want a meal that is going to make you feel good about where the ingredients came from and is a little different I highly recommend.  You also have to like dogs since there is artwork involving dogs all over the wall.  Luckily I also love dogs!
Delicious food and great service- but they should really sweep the floor. It's covered in peanut shells!

Possibly the worst thing to ever happen to me at a restaurant, short of food poisoning or the sight or vermin.  We get there at 8:20, and order and pay for our food at 8:25 pm (stated closing time is 9pm). Nothing is said to us about closing early or that there was in any way a problem with timing.  A waiter brought us our beer as usual and everything seemed otherwise normal.  The first sign that something wasn't right happened when the manager came by our table at 8:30 and stated that there was a last call for anything else we might need, as we had already been given our beer, plates and utensils, we said no thank you and went on waiting for our food.  Seemed odd, as we have always eaten there about that time but thought maybe he was just been unusually attentive.  But oh no, it was part of his plan to close early on a Saturday night.  Next thing we know, our pizza was thrown at us in boxes and at 8:50, we were told we had to take our food to go and to get out.  When I objected, admittedly in shock and anger at this point, the only explanation I as provided was "we close at 9".  Now mind you, this was our second weird experience here. The first time, we waited for over an hour for our pizza and it was given to us rather cold and also in a box; we chalked it up to COVID and gave them several more chances, but this was the straw that broke the camels back - won't be back.  Pretty clear from the other reviews they care nothing about their customers, makes you wonder what's goin

Ordered take out and Patrick took my order, was super helpful and pleasant to speak to! He helped me pick a soup that would help flush out the cold I had! And even recommended a nearby spot for a good immunity shot juice! Highly recommend this place just off the service I received and the ramen was delicious!
I eat here a few times a week and everything on the menu is delicious! Personal favorites are the prosciutto with brie and the chicken pesto panini.

Ladies and gentlemen.. My honey seared chicken... if you can't tell, it's steamed chicken of some sort, which granted is probably healthier, but alas not remotely what I ordered. 

The main issue with this place is they did not have enough people prepping orders. The place was swamped and the girls were doing their best... while also doing their best not to lose their sanity. Probably ok if you don't go while they're busy.
Absolutely love this place, I go there every week, the food and the margaritas are amazing. Gaby was our waitress last time and  she was super attentive totally love her, she did an amazing job.

We ate here yesterday. When we walked in, the waitress was literally making out with someone. We had to ask her to pull her mask up over her nose while she was taking our order. She seemed to get mad and was rude the rest of the lunch. The guy she was making out with kept walking by and staring at us for the entire meal. She handed us our glasses by holding them at the top near the drinking area so we just asked for straws. Food was ok but not impressed with staff.

We pulled up on a Thursday night, so it wasn't too busy. Again, bringing some friends from out of town as they love German food. 

First thing I noticed was that I wasn't sure if the huge front sand(?) lot was for parking or something else. It wasn't paved and it seemed almost too nice of a space just to cover with cars, so I'm still a little unsure.

Second, I love the look of the white building with the large black lettering of their restaurant name. Makes for good advertisement and a cool pic.

Upon entry, you will find a small interior dining area with a few large communal tables. Outside on the other side of the kitchen is more exterior dining and the restrooms as well. 

Our server was pleasant and helpful. She helped us  pick out a beer and a cocktail, both of which we enjoyed. I had the Gretel and it was delicious. My wife and I shared the Bratwurst on a bun with red cabbage with a side of spätzle, and the plastered potatoes (the best!) Our friends had the schnitzel (I didn't try it), a pretzel (yum!), cheese covered spätzle (better than the plain we had), and chicken dumplings (those were tasty.) I thought the bratwurst was well made and tasty. The sauerkraut on the side was a bit odd and crunchier than one expected. I don't know that anyone of us was a huge fan of it. 

I would go back, especially when the weather is warmer, so I could enjoy eating outside. It seems like it would be a wonderful place to go on a nice sunny day with a cool German beer and soft chewy p
Walked here last night.  Closed until further notice.  Wont let me post unless i add more.

I dashed in from my hotel for  a quick cup of coffee and beignets for breakfast. Upon a recommendation from my fabulous waItress,Kiara, I also ordered crawfish beignets. Long story short....I fell in love. Fantastic food!
Really glad I found this place.  Wonderful food, good service at a fair price.  Not sure I'll ever be back to Tucson, but if I am, will definitely be having breakfast here!!!

I ordered ahead for curbside tonight, and when I went to pick up, the food was hot and fresh and plentiful.    They seemed organized and has a rhythm going.  Fries were still hot & crispy when I got home.  My chicken sandwich was tender and hot too.  My daughter enjoyed her toasted ravioli and the pulled pork was awesome too.   Thanks for a yummy dinner, so I didn't have to cook.

Stopped in for lunch after landing in Tampa and this was a pretty good spot. The view is beautiful for sure and definitely order the appetizer of Gator Bites because they were so good! My sliders were just okay, fries were cold, and there was apparently some kind of a water issue so we weren't able to get refills on tea with our meals, so that was odd. Overall a cute place and decent food, though I would order something different next time around.
